Job Summary

jobs.text:
About the role

As an AS400 Technical Lead — COBOL & RPG, you will be responsible for end-to-end technical delivery and hands-on development across AS400 environments. You will combine strong technical expertise with delivery leadership and stakeholder management, working closely with cross-functional technical teams, client stakeholders, and subject matter experts across onshore and offshore delivery models.

In this role, you will

• Own end-to-end delivery and hands-on coding across AS400 , COBOL , RPG , and CL environments, ensuring adherence to scope, quality, and timelines.

• Lead and manage cross-functional technical teams, driving productivity, capacity planning, and delivery governance across onshore and offshore models.

• Act as the primary stakeholder interface, working with client SMEs, resolving dependencies, and securing sign-offs on extracted business rules.

• Provide clear executive status reporting to leadership, including progress, risks, financials, and mitigation plans.

What you need to have to be considered

• 9 years of overall IT experience, with strong experience working with AS400 applications .

• Strong hands-on experience with AS400 environments.

• Strong programming experience with RPG and COBOL/400 .

• Experience with CLLE.

• Experience with SQLRPGLE.

• Experience working with DB2/400.

• Experience leading technical delivery and cross-functional technical teams.

• Strong stakeholder and client-facing communication skills.

These will help you stand out

• Knowledge of AS400 Synon.

• Healthcare industry experience, particularly within Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM).

• Experience with CI/CD practices.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a Remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

Salary and Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $83,250 to $130,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

• Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance

• Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

• 401(k) plan and contributions

• Long-term/Short-term Disability

• Paid Parental Leave

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.text:
Full-time

Description

IBM i (AS/400) Programmer | Remote

Weaver Popcorn Manufacturing

Weaver Popcorn Manufacturing is hiring an IBM i (AS/400) Programmer to develop, maintain, and improve the applications our teams rely on to run the business. This is a remote opportunity with time to work alongside our current programmer before their planned retirement. During the transition, you’ll learn how our applications support manufacturing and business operations and help document that knowledge for the future.

In this role, you’ll use RPG and SQL to solve business problems, improve existing applications, and keep critical systems running reliably. You’ll work directly with end users, business analysts, and IT colleagues to take changes from requirements through development, testing, and support.

What you’ll do
• Develop and maintain applications. Design, write, and enhance RPG programs, scripts, and stored procedures on IBM i. Build business rules into clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
• Translate business needs into technical solutions. Gather and document requirements with end users and business analysts. Review data structures, workflows, and system dependencies before recommending changes.
• Test and troubleshoot. Unit-test and debug code to verify results, protect data integrity, and maintain performance. Investigate application defects and system errors, support users, and resolve issues to minimize downtime.
• Maintain and optimize databases. Create and modify tables, indexes, and relationships in Db2 for i. Write SQL queries and stored procedures, tune slow queries, and use performance metrics to identify bottlenecks.
• Integrate applications. Work with IT and business partners to connect IBM i applications with web services, APIs, and third-party systems. Verify that data moves accurately and reliably between systems.
• Document systems and changes. Maintain program specifications, user guides, system diagrams, and records of code changes and configurations. Capture how key applications work during the transition.
• Protect applications and data. Implement application security and access controls in line with company policies and applicable data protection requirements.
• Collaborate and share knowledge. Work with programmers, system administrators, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and share best practices. Stay current with IBM i tools and development practices.

Requirements

Required qualification
• High school diploma or GED.
Preferred qualifications
• Experience developing or supporting IBM i (AS/400 or iSeries) applications, with strong RPG programming skills.
• Familiarity with Control Language (CL), Data Description Specifications (DDS), and IBM i architecture, file systems, libraries, and security.
• Experience with relational databases and SQL programming on IBM i.
• Familiarity with web services, APIs, and data exchange formats used in system integrations.
• Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, attention to detail, and an ability to write clean, maintainable code.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment, collaborate across departments, and manage competing deadlines.
• Interest in continuing to learn IBM i technologies and development practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Opportunity and Inclusion Statement:

Weaver Popcorn Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to opportunity, inclusion, and creating a workplace where everyone can succeed. Employment and hiring decisions are made based on business need, job requirements, and individual qualifications—without regard to race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local laws.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive environment drives innovation and strengthens our company culture. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Weaver Popcorn Manufacturing is hiring an IBM i (AS/400) Programmer to develop, maintain, and improve applications used to run the business. This remote opportunity includes time working alongside the current programmer before their planned retirement. During the transition, the new hire will learn how applications support manufacturing and business operations and document that knowledge for future use.

The role uses RPG and SQL to address business needs, improve existing applications, and maintain reliable critical systems. The programmer works directly with end users, business analysts, and IT colleagues to take changes from requirements through development, testing, and support.

Responsibilities include developing RPG programs, scripts, and stored procedures; translating business needs into technical solutions; testing and troubleshooting code; maintaining and optimizing Db2 for i databases; integrating IBM i applications with web services, APIs, and third-party systems; documenting systems and changes; applying application security and access controls; and collaborating with technical and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities
• Design, write, and enhance RPG programs, scripts, and stored procedures on IBM i, implementing clean, efficient, maintainable business rules.

• Work with IT and business partners to integrate IBM i applications with web services, APIs, and third-party systems, ensuring data moves accurately and reliably.

• Collaborate with programmers, system administrators, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and share best practices; stay current with IBM i tools and development practices.

• High school diploma or GED.
• Strong RPG programming skills and experience developing or supporting IBM i (AS/400 or iSeries) applications are listed as preferred qualifications.
• Familiarity with Control Language (CL), Data Description Specifications (DDS), and IBM i architecture, file systems, libraries, and security is preferred.
• Experience with relational databases and SQL programming on IBM i is preferred.
• Familiarity with web services, APIs, and data exchange formats used in system integrations is preferred.
• Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, attention to detail, and the ability to write clean, maintainable code are preferred.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment, collaborate across departments, and manage competing deadlines are preferred.
• Interest in continuing to learn IBM i technologies and development practices is preferred.

Nice-to-haves
• Experience developing or supporting IBM i (AS/400 or iSeries) applications, with strong RPG programming skills.
• Familiarity with Control Language (CL), Data Description Specifications (DDS), and IBM i architecture, file systems, libraries, and security.

The Senior Software Engineer - WMS & IBM i Modernization plays a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering modern software solutions that support McKesson's Warehouse Management Systems (WM
jobs.text:
Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer - WMS & IBM i Modernization plays a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering modern software solutions that support McKesson's Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Distribution Center operations. This position focuses on digital application development, APIs, integration services, event-driven architecture, and modern software engineering practices.

The successful candidate will bridge modern technologies with McKesson's IBM i (AS400) environment and bring strong RPG development expertise while contributing to the organization's long-term modernization strategy. This role collaborates with business partners, vendors, and cross-functional technology teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and efficient warehouse solutions.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and support applications supporting Warehouse Management Systems and Distribution Center operations.
• Develop and enhance software solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks.
• Design and implement REST APIs, integration services, and event-driven solutions.
• Maintain and enhance IBM i (AS400) applications utilizing RPGLE and related technologies.
• Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable software solutions.
• Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices.
• Monitor application performance, troubleshoot issues, and perform root-cause analysis.
• Collaborate with vendors, business stakeholders, and technology teams on system integrations and operational improvements.
• Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
• Create and maintain technical documentation and development standards.
• Contribute to modernization initiatives and technology roadmaps for Distribution Center systems.
• Share technical knowledge and mentor team members where appropriate.

Required Qualifications
• 4+ years of software development experience.
• Strong RPGLE development experience within IBM i (AS400) environments.
• Experience with Java, Python, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, or other modern development technologies.
• Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and enterprise integrations.
• Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
• Understanding of microservices, modular architectures, and integration patterns.
• Experience with Agile, SDLC, DevOps practices, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Experience with automated testing and release management practices.

Preferred Qualifications
• IBM i (AS400), RPGLE, CLLE, and ILE development experience.
• Kafka or event-driven architecture experience.
• MongoDB or NoSQL database experience.
• Cloud-native application development experience.
• Legacy application modernization experience.
• Knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), logistics, supply chain, and distribution operations.
• Experience integrating modern applications with legacy enterprise platforms.

Education & Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
• 4+ years of progressive software engineering experience.
• Experience working within Agile delivery teams and enterprise-scale environments.
